method.compression: raw identity response; gzip bytes recomputed at level 9 outside timer
method.cold: application snapshot/sidebar/signature caches cleared, SQLite/OS page cache retained
method.warm: one priming call; signature TTL can expire during a long sample
method.sql: cursor execute time only, excludes fetch/materialization; SELECT rowcount may be -1
method.rows: ORM loaded_as_persistent counts instances; identity-map reuse may undercount repeated SQL rows
method.orm_fetch: ChunkedIteratorResult._fetchall_impl: DB cursor fetching + JSON decoding + ORM materialization; rows are result entries, including repeated reads
method.serialization: separate orjson, FastAPI response validation/serialization and JSONResponse render spans
method.limitations: No network/production PostgreSQL timings, EXPLAIN, browser layout or production-data claim. Instrumentation adds overhead.

note: Supplement measured before any backend change; HEAD includes only correction 1 frontend.
